race.comment: STAR BLAZER (1) made progress last time out, finishing 2.5 lengths from the winner in third at the end of 2100m at Narrandera. This doesn't look as hard so he is one of the main contenders. LIGHTNING FLASH (5) did a great job to score by 6 lengths over today's course and distance last start in a far better run. Well placed and there is no reason she cannot repeat the dose. FORREST GUMP (2) ran below expectations last time at Echuca over 1400m, finishing fourth and beaten 5.5 lengths. Blinkers are removed. Among the leading chances. CAPTAIN BARBOSSA (7) has had three runs back from a spell and while well held in each, he'll be better for them and has trialled well since the latest.
